summary.name: Python Data Science Handbook
summary.one_liner: A free online edition of Jake VanderPlas's Python Data Science Handbook, covering IPython, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib and scikit-learn in Jupyter notebook form.
use_cases: introduction to machine learning with scikit-learn
reading a free copy of the book online
summary.what_it_does: The page hosts the full text of the Python Data Science Handbook by Jake VanderPlas. Its table of contents spans five parts: IPython, Introduction to NumPy, Data Manipulation with Pandas, Visualization with Matplotlib (including Basemap and Seaborn), and Machine Learning with scikit-learn topics such as naive Bayes, linear regression, SVMs, decision trees, PCA, k-means and face detection. The content is available on GitHub as Jupyter notebooks. Code is released under the MIT license and text under CC-BY-NC-ND.
notable: Full book text readable free online, with the source as Jupyter notebooks on GitHub
Covers IPython, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib/Seaborn and scikit-learn in one handbook
Code under MIT license; text under CC-BY-NC-ND
caveats: Text license is CC-BY-NC-ND (non-commercial, no derivatives)
Page invites readers to buy the book to support the author
